parts.name: TagsInputRoot
parts.description: Holds the tags and the input's text and shares them with the parts inside it. It also renders a visually hidden polite live region that announces a highlighted or removed tag, and, with a `name` (or inside a named FieldRoot), one hidden `<input>` per tag for the form.

props.name: value
props.description: The tags. Pass it with `onValueChange` to control them. It may be read from an answer that is loading or guessed over; one that fails is left to the app's `errored` region.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The tags at first, when they aren't controlled. A form reset puts them back.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new tags whenever one is added or removed, or all are cleared. It is called in a change of its own, so it may be an action that saves: the tags and the input are never held by it.

props.name: inputValue
props.description: The input's text. Pass it with `onInputValueChange` to control it.

props.name: onInputValueChange
props.description: Called with the input's text as it is typed, and with what is left once an entry is added (usually an empty string).

props.name: max
props.description: The most tags there may be. An entry past it is refused with the reason `max`.

props.name: allowDuplicates
props.description: Whether the same text may be a tag twice. Otherwise a repeat is refused with the reason `duplicate`.

props.name: delimiter
props.description: Text that finishes an entry when typed or pasted, as Enter does. `null` for none, so only Enter (and `addOnBlur`, `addOnPaste`) adds.

props.name: addOnBlur
props.description: Add what was typed when the input loses focus.

props.name: addOnPaste
props.description: Add everything pasted at once, split at the delimiter and at line breaks, the last part included. Without it a paste is like typing: the parts before a delimiter are added and the rest stays in the input.

props.name: validate
props.description: Whether an entry may be a tag. Entries are trimmed first; one it returns false for is refused with the reason `invalid`. It is called synchronously, so it must be a plain function, not an action.

props.name: onValueInvalid
props.description: Called for each refused entry with `{ value, reason }`, where `reason` is `duplicate`, `max` or `invalid`. The refused text stays in the input to be corrected.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the tags input can't be used or focused. Also true inside a disabled FieldRoot. Disabled while its input has focus (`disabled={pending? saved}`), the input takes focus back when it is enabled again.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the tags can be read and highlighted but not added or removed.

props.name: required
props.description: Whether at least one tag is needed for the form to be valid. The input is natively `required` while there is no tag, so text typed but not yet added counts as filled and the form submits without it.

props.name: name
props.description: The name each tag is submitted under, one entry per tag. Taken from an enclosing FieldRoot when not given.

props.name: messages
props.description: What the live region says: `highlighted(value)`, `removed(value)` and `cleared`. Defaults: "<value>, press Backspace or Delete to remove" (only the value when read-only), "<value> removed" and "All tags removed".

dataAttributes.name: data-dirty
dataAttributes.description: Inside a FieldRoot: present once the tags have changed.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the tags input is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-filled
dataAttributes.description: Inside a FieldRoot: present when there is at least one tag.

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Inside a FieldRoot: present while the input has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-invalid
dataAttributes.description: Inside a FieldRoot: present when the field is invalid.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present when the tags input is read-only.

dataAttributes.name: data-required
dataAttributes.description: Present when the tags input is required.

dataAttributes.name: data-touched
dataAttributes.description: Inside a FieldRoot: present once the input has been focused and left.

dataAttributes.name: data-valid
dataAttributes.description: Inside a FieldRoot: present when the field has been validated and is valid.

parts.name: TagsInputControl
parts.description: The box that holds the tags and the input. A press on its empty space puts the caret in the input.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the tags input is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present when the tags input is read-only.

dataAttributes.name: data-required
dataAttributes.description: Present when the tags input is required.

parts.name: TagsInputTag
parts.description: One tag. Render one per entry of the `tagsInput` context's `tags`. A press on it highlights it and keeps the caret in the input. It is never focused itself: focus stays in the input.

props.name: index
props.description: The tag's position in the value: `tag.index` for each `tag` of the context's `tags`.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the tags input is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-highlighted
dataAttributes.description: Present while the tag is highlighted: Backspace or Delete removes it.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present when the tags input is read-only.

parts.name: TagsInputTagText
parts.description: The tag's text: its value, unless given children.

dataAttributes.name: data-highlighted
dataAttributes.description: Present while its tag is highlighted.

parts.name: TagsInputTagRemove
parts.description: A button that removes its tag. Named "Remove <value>" unless given an `aria-label`. It is not in the tab order (Backspace and Delete remove a highlighted tag), and pressing it leaves focus in the input. Disabled while the tags input is disabled or read-only.

parts.name: TagsInputInput
parts.description: The text input. Enter or the delimiter adds what was typed; Backspace or ArrowLeft at the start of the text highlights the last tag. Inside a FieldRoot it is the field's control: labelled by FieldLabel and described by FieldDescription and FieldError.

dataAttributes.name: data-dirty
dataAttributes.description: Inside a FieldRoot: present once the tags have changed.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the tags input is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-filled
dataAttributes.description: Inside a FieldRoot: present when there is at least one tag.

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Inside a FieldRoot: present while the input has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-invalid
dataAttributes.description: Inside a FieldRoot: present when the field is invalid.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present when the tags input is read-only.

dataAttributes.name: data-required
dataAttributes.description: Present when the tags input is required.

dataAttributes.name: data-touched
dataAttributes.description: Inside a FieldRoot: present once the input has been focused and left.

dataAttributes.name: data-valid
dataAttributes.description: Inside a FieldRoot: present when the field has been validated and is valid.

parts.name: TagsInputClear
parts.description: A button that removes every tag and the typed text, then puts the caret in the input. Not in the tab order, like the remove buttons. Give it an `aria-label` when its content is an icon.

props.name: keepMounted
props.description: Render the button even when there is nothing to clear.

dataAttributes.description: Present when the tags input is disabled.
